items.name: drag-drop-reorder
items.title: Drag Drop Reorder
items.description: A polished drag-and-drop reorderable list component.

items.name: liquid-scroll-progress
items.title: Liquid Scroll Progress
items.description: A fixed liquid progress indicator that fills the pipe, connectors, and cards in response to wheel or touch input.

items.name: jelly-toolbar
items.title: Jelly Toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar with a solid jelly/slime blob that stretches and morphs between items as you move your cursor.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Four pagination styles — Pills, Outline, Compact, With Input — each independently functional, with a shared Framer Motion sliding active-page indicator.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: Four OTP input styles — Classic, Underline, Pill, Filled — each with a spring-driven focus indicator that glides to the exact measured position of the active slot.

items.name: elastic-dropdown
items.title: Elastic Dropdown
items.description: A compact dropdown whose outer shape physically stretches open — one continuous spring-driven SVG surface that bows, overshoots, and settles back into the trigger, not a menu that fades or slides in.

items.name: buttons
items.title: Buttons
items.description: Four animated button interactions — Staggered Letter Lift, Single Liquid Bubble, Magnetic, Cursor Compression — monochrome, independently stateful, and built on identical geometry.
